_comment: Safe for every character AND the player to know from turn one. Sourced only from nautilus-house-cast.pdf. Contains no solution facts (no true murder room, no body-mover, no Ammonite hiding spot).

setting.location: Nautilus House, an island mansion off the coast of Maine
setting.isolation: No phone signal. House cameras never cover private rooms (bedrooms, studies, bathrooms).
setting.occasion: Vance invited six people for a weekend and promised to name his heir at Sunday noon.
setting.inciting_incident: Vance was murdered on Saturday night.
setting.storm_note: A storm strands everyone on the island for nine hours before help (and the boat) arrives.
setting.player_role: The player is the detective and must identify the killer before the boat comes.

anchor_clues.statement: The body was staged. Ignatius Vance was not killed in the room where he was found.
The murder weapon was a prized fossil from Vance's collection, called "the Ammonite." It is missing from the house and has been hidden somewhere on the island.

public_discovery_facts: Ignatius Vance's body was discovered in the Library.
There are exactly six living suspects: Marrow, Wren, Hettie, Odette, Barnaby, and Slate.
Everyone agrees the storm made it impossible for anyone to leave the island that night.
known_to: all six characters and the player, from the start of the game
